nav.books_hint: The catalogue, stock, deliveries and typed sales
nav.suppliers_hint: Their terms, what the shop owes, and statements
money.help.vendor_purchase_credit: Goods bought from a vendor, to be paid later. No money moves now; what the shop owes the vendor goes up.
money.help.vendor_purchase_paid: Goods bought from a vendor and paid there and then. Money leaves an account; nothing is owed.
money.help.vendor_payment: Paying a vendor what the shop owes. It pays off purchases; it isn't an expense.
money.help.vendor_credit_note: A vendor takes goods back or gives credit. What the shop owes goes down; no money moves.
money.help.publisher_payment: Paying a publisher for books. It pays off what is owed for copies sold or delivered; it isn't an expense. Say which sales it covers.
money.help.publisher_refund: A publisher returns money to the shop.
money.help.publisher_writeoff: Money paid to a publisher in advance that won't come back as books, written off.
money.bill_help: The number on the vendor's bill. The same number twice for one vendor isn't allowed (case, spaces and dashes don't matter).
money.covers_help: The latest day of sales this payment settles. Suggested from what is owed; you can change it.
money.no_suppliers: None yet. A shareholder adds them in Vendors and publishers.
money.settled_to: Earlier payments settled sales up to {date}.
money.suggest_covers: With this payment, sales up to {date} are settled.
dup.vendor_bill: This bill number was already entered for this vendor ({id}).
dup.vendor_bill_match: A vendor purchase of the same amount was entered within {days} days. This may be the same bill.
dup.names_vendor: The note names the vendor {name}. Paying a vendor is a vendor entry, not an expense.
dup.names_publisher: The note names the publisher {name}. Paying a publisher is a publisher payment, not an expense.
val.isbn_taken: This ISBN is already used by "{title}".
books.unknown_title: "{title}" isn't in the catalogue. Add it first, or pick a title from the list.
books.title: Title
books.author: Author
books.sell_price_help: Leave empty to sell at the printed price less the publisher's shop discount.
books.aliases_help: Other spellings, romanised names or names on memos, separated by commas.
books.empty: No titles yet. Add them, or record a delivery.
books.lines_help: Type a title to pick it from the catalogue. A title that isn't there is added with this delivery.
books.line_new: New title: it will be added to the catalogue.
books.no_sales_day: No book sales typed for this day.
suppliers.intro: What the shop owes each vendor and publisher. Open one for its statement.
suppliers.commission_help: The publisher's discount to the shop. A copy costs the printed price less this.
suppliers.sell_discount_help: Books from this publisher sell at the printed price less this, unless a title has its own price.
suppliers.opening_due_help: What the shop already owed when you started using the app.
